name: medical_claim
description: Pay a provider's health insurance claim, or hold it for pre-payment review
subject: provider
hold: Should this provider's pending claim be held for pre-payment review because the provider shows signs of billing for services that did not happen, of billing higher-level services than were given, of a kickback or patient-recruitment scheme, or of a provider that was excluded before? Judge fraud, waste and abuse only, not whether the treatment was clinically right.

typologies.phantom_billing: Phantom billing: claims for patients who were not seen, often from a stolen or bought list of member ids
typologies.upcoding: Upcoding: real visits billed at a higher level or a more expensive code than the care supports
typologies.kickback_scheme: Kickback or recruitment scheme: recruited patients, a referring doctor and a lab or supplier that work together to bill expensive services
typologies.excluded_provider: Returning bad actor: a provider that was excluded or terminated enrols again under a new name
typologies.legit: Legitimate provider billing for care it gave, including busy, specialist and new practices

reasons.impossible_volume: The time or the number of visits billed in one day is more than one clinician can do
reasons.volume_spike: The claim volume is far above the provider's usual volume, with no reason such as a seasonal outbreak
reasons.level_above_peers: The share of highest-level visit codes is far above the share for peers of the same specialty
reasons.level_shift: The provider moved suddenly to higher-level codes compared with its own history
reasons.diagnosis_not_supporting: The diagnoses are too simple to support the level or the service billed
reasons.distant_patients: Many patients live far from the practice
reasons.weekend_or_night_services: The service date and time of office visits fall on weekends or at night, when the practice is closed. When the claim was sent does not count
reasons.member_complaints: Patients said they did not receive the services billed
reasons.shared_patients_with_fraud: The patients were also billed by providers that were found to commit fraud
reasons.referral_loop: The same referring doctor and the same lab appear on most claims, and the referring doctor is linked to fraud findings
reasons.high_cost_tests: Expensive genetic tests, lab panels or equipment are ordered for most patients with little clinical reason
reasons.linked_to_excluded: The owner, the bank account, the address or the portal computer is shared with a provider that was excluded or terminated
reasons.bulk_upload_from_new_device: Many claims were uploaded at once from a device or a network the provider has not used before, with no eligibility checks
reasons.payment_account_changed: The account the insurer pays into was changed in the same portal visit as the claims, or shortly before
reasons.resubmitted_at_higher_level: Denied claims were resubmitted with a higher-level code and no new documentation
reasons.shared_portal_device: The portal is used from a computer that other providers also sign in from
